decision.rationale: I recommend a provisional credit of 453.53 EUR for one of the two postings. The time limit is met: TXN-008034 posted on 2026-08-24 and the dispute was opened on 2026-10-30, 67 days later, which is within the 120-day limit. The card has two purchases at MER-000052 (LARKSPUR GETAWAYS), both for 45353 minor units, both made on 2026-08-23 and both posted on 2026-08-24: TXN-008033 at 10:27:18Z and the disputed TXN-008034 at 10:30:18Z. Both carry the same authorisation, AUTH-008230. That authorisation was approved for 45353, so one authorisation was posted twice. The card has no refunds. Under duplicate-same-authorisation, the extra posting, TXN-008034 for 45353, gets a provisional credit. That is below the 3,000.00 EUR limit in provisional-credit. The credit is for one posting only, not both. A separate purchase at the same merchant, TXN-002867 for 45080 on 2026-09-07, uses a different authorisation (AUTH-002943) and is not part of this dispute.
